name: Bulk E-commerce Active
description: Start the next commerce campaign with a more focused audience. Find available e-commerce activity signals, shape audience and remarketing segments around records worth review, and keep the boundary clear: the result is not an order, purchase intent or platform-activity record.

result_fields.name: number
result_fields.description: The original submitted E.164 number, used to write the result back to customer, lead or audience records. It does not contain order, product or platform-activity information.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether an available e-commerce activity signal was returned. It can support audience review and campaign planning, but does not represent an order, transaction value, purchase intent or a specific platform activity.
